Do candlestick patterns improve my momentum trades?

BT29 · 7,447 past momentum-engine trades, 2022–2026 · 238 charted · generated 2026-09-12 21:31 IST

Detector candles-v3-20260912 · 5-minute bars built with the live resample_5m · formations found by a prefix scan, so nothing on a chart uses a candle that had not closed yet. Every card is a real past trade of the momentum engine, entered on its own criteria (gainer, RVOL, setup, trigger) — the candlestick is only asked whether it would have been a useful extra filter.

Result: it does not help. Across 7,447 past trades, the 165 where a bullish v3 formation had closed in the four 5-minute bars before the fill returned -0.115 percentage points in gross terms versus the rest (t = -1.57). The pre-registered bar was +0.30 pp with t ≥ 2.0, so the pattern is not being added to the entry rules. Use this page to check that the labels themselves are right — that part holds up.
Population: one trade per symbol-day only, and only runs made after the breakeven-lock defect was fixed on 2026-09-06. The multi-entry arm (2nd, 3rd, 5th re-entry on the same stock) is excluded — it was killed as a strategy and its trades are not ones you would take. Each card shows the pullback ordinal and how big the nearest formation was relative to the recent average range, so a correctly-labelled but insignificant candle is visible as such.
